name: Unlabeled Sample Compression of Full Cube
details: The full cube is the VC-dimension-$n$ maximum class on its $n$-point domain.
proof: The corrected maximum-class construction gives an unlabeled compression scheme of size equal to the VC dimension, hence at most $n$.  Conversely, the full domain is shattered, so the general VC-dimension lower bound for unlabeled compression gives at least $n$.
